reviews.review:
Updated after 150 hours.

Even in just the first hour of gameplay, this game looks polished, and there's loads of cool features. At its core, it's a deckbuilder where you get to improve your cards as the game goes on.

In a single fight that lasts a few rounds, your basic guys can go from dealing under 10 damage, to well over 100. The mechanics of the starting cards ensure a lot of progression in a short amount of time, and this feels very fun.

The help system is nice and useful, and the tutorial does what it needs to do.

The ascension system is fun and well thought out. It lets you spend mana to get 'global' benefits instead of 'local' - eg, one of the starting guys has a bonus, when it attacks, give another random NikNak +3 Attack. This gives one of the unplayed cards in your hand +3 Attack. If I ascend it, then after I use ANY of my cards to attack, a random card gets the +3 Attack bonus.

I like the graphics and the music.

The whole game feels great right on launch day. Highly recommended for anyone who enjoys deck building!


After six hours:

I'm having a lot of fun with this game. I've won a few times, and been obliterated several times. The numbers really do get high, and sometimes you can win, and sometimes you can't.

I really like how you can lose a few battles and keep going.
I like how different some of the NikNaks, spells and artifacts are. There's a lot of valid deck builds. Choosing a bigger hand, more mana and more spirit are all valid choices.

Definitely a smartly designed game!

Current thoughts: I'd like some more options to be unlocked after playing. I think I've only had one so far. Some of them feel really far away, so some more would be nice. eg, there's an unlock after beating the game, and beating it on what I believe is the third difficulty never, but nothing for defeating it on the second difficulty level.


After 150 hours:

The developer is very responsive on the Discord server, and breaking the game is really fun!
The game is being updated and improved frequently. Can't ask for anything else :)
